scriptText:
I. PART I

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create an animated cinematic sequence in a French graphic novel aesthetic featuring @OSCAR as OSCAR (Voice: @voice_oscar), a dry mentor adventurer, @RUBY as RUBY (voice: @voice_ruby), a restless young rogue, and @ARTHUR as ARTHUR (voice: @voice_arthur), a burly craftsman, as domestic afternoon boredom erupts into a spirited footrace through a traditional Japanese residence.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain strict spatial continuity along the south-to-north axis from the sunlit veranda across the tatami living area into the hallway and up the cedar staircase. Preserve prop persistence including the spinning ceramic teacup, condensation on the barley tea glass, the dropped wooden die, and the trailing apron ties. Ensure match-on-action transitions between sitting, scrambling, sprinting, and stair-climbing without crossing the line of action. Avoid sudden jumps in character physical orientation, hand tracking, or environmental lighting.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: French animated cinema aesthetic, Franco-Belgian graphic novel style, contemporary editorial illustration, semi-ligne claire contour inking, muted digital watercolor wash, textured gouache shading, matte surface finish, subtle pigment grain
Palette: Sun-bleached cedar brown, aged tatami straw gold, muted indigo, deep olive green, pastel melon and cream, warm tobacco tan, bright marigold yellow
Lighting: High-angle warm afternoon sunlight streaming through southern veranda glass, casting soft diffused rectangular shadows and ambient golden bounce
Location: Showa-modern Japanese suburban interior featuring aged cedar wood trims, woven tatami flooring, sliding paper fusuma doors, narrow polished wooden hallway, and steep cedar staircase
Wardrobe Oscar: Slate-grey knit cardigan draped over unbuttoned off-white linen band-collar shirt, tailored navy chino trousers, thick oatmeal wool socks
Wardrobe Ruby: Oversized pastel melon-and-cream striped knit sweater slipping off left shoulder, rolled indigo denim dungarees, marigold socks, brass geometric hair clips pinning copper bangs
Wardrobe Arthur: Deep-olive waffle-knit thermal henley, tobacco-tan corduroy lounge trousers, faded-canvas craftsman apron with brass rivets and shallow pockets, dark woven neckerchief
Sound: Diegetic ambient hum of vintage oscillating electric fan, distant summer cicadas outside the open garden veranda, natural room resonance
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
WS, LOW LEVEL, camera positioned near the east tatami wall framing the sun-drenched living room along the north-south axis. Warm afternoon light washes across woven straw mats from the open southern veranda in background left, where Oscar sits cross-legged on polished floorboards holding a frosted glass of barley tea. In the center midground, Arthur lies sprawled on his stomach behind the low cedar tea table with his chin flat against the dark wood beside a spinning ceramic teacup. In the western foreground right, Ruby lies inverted on an indigo floor cushion with her legs propped up the plaster wall, balancing a wooden die on the bridge of her nose beneath the breeze of a pale-green oscillating corner fan.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] WS, LOW LEVEL, fixed setup -> [BLOCK] Oscar cross-legged at open veranda background left, Arthur sprawled along north side of cedar table center midground, Ruby inverted on indigo cushion foreground right -> [ACT] Pale-green electric fan clicks and pans a gentle breeze across Ruby's copper bangs as Arthur idly taps the spinning teacup -> Ruby says (weary drawl without moving jaw) {Arthur... if I die of boredom in your living room...} -> <Gentle mechanical click and rhythmic whir of oscillating fan blades>
[CAM] MCU, LOW LEVEL, facing north -> [BLOCK] Arthur centered with chin pressed flat on cedar tabletop, teacup spinning between ceramic saucers in immediate foreground -> [ACT] Arthur's eyes lazily track the spinning cup without lifting his heavy head -> Ruby says O.S. (flat exhaustion) {...put in the papers that it was tragic and mysterious.} -> Arthur says (deadpan grumble without looking up) {I'll tell them you passed away doing what you loved: complaining.} -> <Ceramic teacup scraping and spinning in tight circles on polished wood>
[CAM] MS, EYE LEVEL, looking south toward veranda -> [BLOCK] Oscar seated cross-legged at open veranda threshold, frosted tea glass in right hand, bamboo garden bathed in sunlight behind him -> [ACT] Oscar raises the condensation-slick glass to take a slow sip, lowers it gently to the floorboard beside his left knee, and offers a knowing smirk -> Oscar says (dry, amused murmur) {Well. We could always go back up.} -> <Ice cubes softly clinking against glass>
[CAM] MCU, HIGH ANGLE, tilted down at cushion -> [BLOCK] Ruby inverted on indigo cushion with legs resting up the pale plaster wall, face tilted toward ceiling -> [ACT] Ruby's eyes snap wide at Oscar's words, her eyebrows twitching as the wooden die slides off her nose bridge, bounces off her cheek, and rolls across the woven straw -> <Light wooden die clattering and tumbling over tatami mat>
[CAM] MS, LOW ANGLE, looking northwest across tea table -> [BLOCK] Arthur in center midground shoving his upper body upward from table surface, open northern sliding fusuma doors visible in background -> [ACT] Arthur jerks his chin upright off the wood, locks a wide-eyed stare toward Oscar at the veranda, then instantly pivots his gaze north toward the hallway -> <Abrupt creak of shifting floor timber and heavy palms pressing cedar wood>
[CAM] FS, TRACKING PAN, moving north alongside action -> [BLOCK] Ruby springing from floor cushion frame-left, Arthur scrambling up from table center, Oscar watching calmly from veranda frame-right -> [ACT] Ruby flips backward off her cushion onto her feet and bolts through the open sliding fusuma doors as Arthur pushes off the table edge, sending a seat cushion skidding -> Ruby says (gasping, exhilarated shout) {Dibs on the front seat!} -> <Wool socks squeaking and scrambling across polished cedar doorway>
[CAM] MS, TRACKING BACKWARDS, moving northward down hallway -> [BLOCK] Ruby charging down left corridor wall, Arthur surging into frame along right corridor wall -> [ACT] Ruby sprints with marigold socks sliding for grip as Arthur closes the gap with long strides, angling his broad shoulder to box her out at the corridor bend -> Arthur says O.S. (breathless bellow) {Hey! It's my house!} -> <Heavy thudding footsteps pounding rapidly down wooden hallway floorboards>
[CAM] MS, PROFILE TRACKING, moving alongside turn -> [BLOCK] Arthur leading by a half-step on frame-right, Ruby trailing slightly on frame-left near corner wall -> [ACT] Ruby flashes a breathless grin and reaches across with her right hand to snatch the trailing canvas tie of Arthur's apron, yanking backward to stall his momentum -> Arthur says O.S. (strained protest) {No pulling!} -> <Rough canvas strap snapping taut under sudden pull>
[CAM] FS, LOW TILT UP, looking up steep wooden staircase -> [BLOCK] Arthur rounding the bottom newel post on right side of steps, Ruby diving low to the inner left wall beneath the cedar handrail -> [ACT] Arthur yanks his apron tie free from her grip and lunges up the steep steps multiple treads per stride as Ruby scrambles upward on hands and knees beneath the railing -> <Rhythmic heavy stomping and socked feet scrambling for purchase on wooden treads>
[CAM] MS, LOW ANGLE, looking toward staircase base -> [BLOCK] Oscar entering hallway frame-left by polished bottom newel post, Arthur and Ruby visible scrambling around upper stair landing in background -> [ACT] Oscar rests his right hand on the smooth wooden newel post, chuckling softly as he steps onto the bottom stair with unhurried, measured strides -> <Distant chaotic footsteps and laughter fading into upper workshop bedroom>
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART II

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a seamless scene continuation from @PREVIOUS_CLIP as PREVIOUS_CLIP featuring @OSCAR as OSCAR (Voice: @voice_oscar), @RUBY as RUBY (voice: @voice_ruby), @ARTHUR as ARTHUR (voice: voice_arthur), where three companions trigger a mysterious levitating @OBJECT as VECTOR FIELD (stone relic) in an upstairs Japanese bedroom and float into zero-gravity as their room disintegrates into golden light.
[[/INTENT]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Ensure absolute visual continuity from PREVIOUS_CLIP, maintaining identical anime-style line art rendering, lighting, character faces, and wardrobe. Preserve exact spatial alignment across room transitions, inheriting Oscar's stair-climbing movement before establishing the upstairs bedroom geometry. Respect prop permanence and hand placement relative to the central stone disc.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: Hand-drawn 2D anime illustration, crisp ink outlines, warm cell-shaded textures
Palette: Golden afternoon sunlight, warm amber, indigo blue, rich cedar brown, radiant yellow-gold light
Lighting: Direct afternoon sun beaming through grid windows, casting bright geometric shadows, transitioning to ethereal glowing gold illumination
Location: Detail of Arthur upstairs room -> Traditional Japanese upstairs bedroom featuring tatami mat flooring, folded futons against sliding shoji screens, paper-grid transom windows, and a low polished cedar workbench centered in the room, visually distinct from downstairs
Prop: @OBJECT as VECTOR FIELD relic -> Circular matte-charcoal stone disc resting on a dark velvet cloth, featuring three circular outer nodes linked by thin recessed grooves with faint amber idle light
Wardrobe: Oscar in grey cardigan over beige shirt and blue pinstripe pants; Ruby in oversized mustard-yellow and white striped sweater over dark denim overalls; Arthur in dark navy crewneck sweatshirt with beige apron tied at waist
Audio: Diegetic sound effects and dialogue only, natural room acoustics, atmospheric wind, zero background music
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
MS, LOW ANGLE, framed from the wooden base of the staircase as Oscar places his socked foot onto the lower riser while holding the cedar support post under warm hallway light.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MS, LOW ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Oscar at staircase base looking upward -> [ACT] Oscar climbs the steps with unhurried strides, ascending out of frame -> <Socked feet creaking against smooth wooden steps>
[CAM 02] MWS, NEW LOCATION: ARTHUR UPSTAIRS BEDROOM -> [BLOCK] Arthur kneels on the north side of a low cedar workbench, forearms resting flat on the surface; Ruby crouches on the west side opposite him; the dark stone disc rests on a velvet cloth between them -> [ACT] Arthur heaves his chest, catching his breath while Ruby hovers her right index finger a short distance above the western node -> Arthur says (gasping) {Ruby, don't touch it—} -> [STATE OUT] Arthur holds his breath as Ruby keeps her hand hovering stubbornly
[CAM 03] MCS, WEST-FACING OVER-SHOULDER ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Frame centered on Ruby crouching west of the table, her finger hovering above the charcoal stone while Arthur sits out of frame to the north -> [ACT] Ruby tilts her head playfully, refusing to pull her finger back while listening to Arthur speak O.S. -> Arthur says O.S. (exasperated) {I'm serious! I haven't even stabilized the resonance!} -> <Deep humming mechanical tone> -> Ruby raises her eyebrows with a mischievous smile
[CAM 04] MS, EAST DOORWAY ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Oscar steps smoothly through the open sliding paper door on the east wall, walking toward the south side of the workbench -> [ACT] Oscar slides his hands casually into his grey cardigan pockets, unaffected by the chase -> Ruby turns her head toward Oscar as he stops across from Arthur -> Ruby says (curious) {Oscar, how does this one even work?} -> Oscar leans forward slightly, giving a slow, nonchalant shrug
[CAM 03] MCS, NORTH-FACING ANGLE -> [BLOCK] Arthur sits on his knees north of the workbench, looking up across the table at Oscar positioned on the south side -> [ACT] Arthur's frustrated scowl gradually softens into amusement as he listens to Oscar O.S. -> Oscar says O.S. (relaxed) {Does it matter?} -> Arthur breaks into a broad, eager grin -> Arthur says (enthusiastic) {Nope.} -> Arthur raises his right hand, hovering his index finger directly over the northern node
[CAM 02] MWS, TRIANGLE BLOCKING SETUP -> [BLOCK] Arthur north, Ruby west, Oscar south surrounding the low cedar workbench -> [ACT] Arthur steadies his posture over the table -> Arthur says (determined) {Let's just do this.} -> Ruby nods eagerly, positioning her finger over the western node while Oscar pulls his hands from his pockets to hover over the southern node -> Oscar says (smiling) {You ready for an adventure?} -> Ruby says (grinning) {I was born ready.} -> All three simultaneously lower their index fingertips onto their respective circular nodes
[CAM 05] HIGH ANGLE MS -> [BLOCK] Overhead top-down view centered on the Vector Field disc on the dark velvet cloth as three fingertips make contact with the outer nodes -> [ACT] The three circular nodes depress slightly into the matte surface -> <Sharp mechanical metallic click> -> All three abruptly pull their hands back in reaction -> [VFX] The charcoal stone disc levitates smoothly into the air, hovering independently above the cedar table
[CAM 01] MWS, EYE-LEVEL ELEVATED TRACK -> [BLOCK] Three companions grouped around the central levitating artifact -> [VFX] The narrow channels of the stone disc erupt into brilliant, liquid-gold light, racing inward to ignite the central sphere into a radiant sun -> [ACT] Gravity gives out as Arthur's knees lift off the tatami mats, and Ruby floats weightlessly upward with her yellow sweater fluttering -> Ruby says (breathless) {Ah!} -> Swirling ribbons of luminous energy expand outward around their floating bodies
[CAM 04] MS, DYNAMIC ZERO-GRAVITY TRACK -> [BLOCK] Oscar and Ruby floating suspended in mid-air near the eastern shoji windows -> [ACT] Oscar drifts horizontally with a gentle tilt while concentric geometry rings of golden light ripple through the room -> <Rushing gust of warm sky wind> -> [VFX] The paper window screens shatter outward into a cloud of sparkling golden dust motes
[CAM 05] TOP VIEW OVERHEAD SHOT -> [BLOCK] Bird's-eye view looking straight down at Arthur, Ruby, and Oscar suspended in a symmetrical triangle around the blazing relic -> [VFX] The surrounding tatami floor, sliding doors, and timber ceiling dissolve away into an infinite golden sky -> <Ethereal wind roaring> -> Liquid golden light floods the frame entirely -> [TRANS] Fade to white
[</BRIEF>]
